counterfactual_text: A conical sand pile grows below the cup while the dry sand inside the cup remains unchanged.
positive_text: A continuous sand stream leaves the cup, the sand inside decreases, and a conical pile grows directly below.
semantic_text: Dry sand pours from a cup onto a flat table, emptying the cup as a conical pile grows below. Initial scene: A fixed side view of one cup filled with dry sand, held slightly tilted above a clean flat table while all sand remains inside. The cup opening, visible source sand, clear vertical space, and broad empty table area below are fully visible and unobstructed under neutral lighting. Required visible entities: one cup filled with dry sand; one flat table; clear pile-forming area below the cup. At the beginning: cup: filled with dry sand and slightly tilted; sand: fully retained inside the cup; table: clear beneath the cup with an empty pile region. Required layout: cup opening faces the clear table area below; source sand, transfer region, and pile area fit inside the frame; broad table surface remains visible around the intended pile. Required state changes: sand amount in cup: high to low; sand pile size: absent to larger; sand configuration: cup contents to stream and conical pile. These event variables are allowed to change: cup orientation; sand amount inside the cup; sand-stream shape; pile height, width, and slope. Preserve throughout: static side-view camera; cup identity; flat table and background; one cup; one flat table; the same dry sand and local scene.
